items.title: Field map and nervous-system foundations
items.rationale: Establishes a zero-subject-specific-knowledge entry point before interfaces or algorithms.

items.title: Neural recording and measurement modalities
items.rationale: Covers invasive, noninvasive, electrical, magnetic, hemodynamic, and optical observation across spatial and temporal scales.

items.title: Instrumentation and signal processing
items.rationale: Builds the acquisition chain from sampling and analog front ends through noise, artifacts, filtering, events, and spectra.

items.title: Neural coding, decoding, encoding, and data analysis
items.rationale: Maps neural data structure, statistical variability, population representations, decoding, encoding, ML, drift, and evaluation.

items.title: Neural stimulation and modulation
items.rationale: Covers electrical and non-electrical perturbation while separating mechanism, targeting, safety, and therapeutic context.

items.title: BCI, neuroprosthetics, and closed-loop systems
items.rationale: Covers sensory and motor restoration, invasive and noninvasive BCI, bidirectional interfaces, and adaptive closed loops.

items.title: Implants, materials, peripheral interfaces, and neural tissue engineering
items.rationale: Adds biological interface response, materials, packaging, electronics, chronic reliability, peripheral interfaces, and regenerative platforms.

items.title: Translation, regulation, and human-centered design
items.rationale: Connects intended use and risk-benefit to verification, preclinical evidence, clinical evaluation, regulation, and usability.

items.title: Cybersecurity, neuroethics, equity, and data governance
items.rationale: Treats neural technologies as human systems with privacy, agency, consent, identity, security, accessibility, equity, and governance obligations.

items.title: Integrated systems, frontier methods, and research literacy
items.rationale: Prepares the learner to integrate modalities, assess advanced computation, reproduce results, design systems, form questions, and refresh the frontier.
